newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore May oil output rose 0.2-pct yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: Singapore May oil output rose 0.2-pct yr-on-yr.

text.p: Singapore's May petroleum products manufacturing output rose a marginal 0.2-percent compared with the same month a year before, the Economic Development Board (EDB) said on Monday.
"Cumulative output for the first five months of 1997 was 8.3 percent lower than the same period in 1996," EDB said in a statement.
Industry sources said the lower cumulative output was due to the shutdown of crude units at the Mobil and Singapore Refining Co in March for maintenance.
EDB also said the petrochemicals industry continued to expand in May with new capacities.
"The output increase of 33.6 percent in May brought the cumulative output growth for the first five months of 1997 to 32.7 percent," EDB said.
In April the second Singapore petrochemical complex began production.
